{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display the first few rows and basic info
print(df.head())
print(df.info())

# Check for missing values in the key columns
baseline_missing = df['baseline_biomarker'].isnull().sum()
followup_missing = df['followup_biomarker'].isnull().sum()

print(f"Missing baseline: {baseline_missing}")
print(f"Missing follow-up: {followup_missing}")"}
